_comment: The lava river section of the ring: the deck between bearings 292.3 and 338.3 (r 46.7..57.3) replaced by a river brimming at y=22.3, 0.7 m under the deck, with rock shores at both ends. It issues from a low slot at the foot of the shaft wall (300.3..306.3 deg, head y=22.75, so neither the wall nor the deck above it is ever cut) and leaves over the inner lip as ONE sheet down the section's whole inner edge, 6-8 m with tears. Seven rock pillars stand 1.2 m out of it, tops flat at y=23.5, 7.00 m centre to centre; the three inner ones carry a cover fin to y=27.3. Authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity. TWO surfaces: HellRock (the tower atlas) and LavaRiver (its own tiling sheet, emissive, streaked along the flow, double-sided for the fall). LakeCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node -- rock above y 22.5, pillar tops and sides, fins, the slot floor -- and carries NO lava and NO fall: the scene's TrapVolume owns the kill. LavaSurface is an empty at the river height, centre of the section, for placing that TrapVolume.
